description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI screen for the 'Connect' tab in an Android application, allowing users to connect to a gateway via setup code or manual host/port/TLS configurations, showing status, diagnostics, and advanced options.

classes.name: ConnectInputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for input modes, either SetupCode or Manual.

methods.name: ConnectTabScreen
methods.description: Composable function that constructs the entire connect tab UI, managing connection states, inputs, diagnostics, and advanced controls.

methods.name: MethodChip
methods.description: Composable for a toggle button representing a connection method (e.g., Setup Code or Manual).

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Composable for quick preset buttons for host configurations.

methods.name: CommandBlock
methods.description: Displays a styled command-line snippet for user instructions.

methods.name: EndpointPreview
methods.description: Displays the resolved endpoint URL preview.
